odorstrike.name: ODORSTRIKE Fabric Mist — 50ml
odorstrike.descriptor: Pocket-sized odor killer for your clothes.
odorstrike.summary: A 50ml pocket spray that traps and neutralizes odor in fabric so clothes stay fresh between washes. For fabrics and clothing only. Not for application to skin.

images.alt: ODORSTRIKE 50ml fabric mist bottle on a clean white background
ODORSTRIKE 50ml bottle held in hand showing pocket size reference
ODORSTRIKE being sprayed onto a shirt to refresh the fabric
ODORSTRIKE tucked into a gym bag pocket, ready to use anywhere
Diagram of how ODORSTRIKE traps odor molecules in fabric

odorstrike.ingredients: Water, modified cyclodextrin (odor-trapping complex), solubiliser, fabric-safe fragrance, preservative. Free from harsh bleaches. For use on fabrics and clothing only. Not for application to skin.
